body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Huge thoughtful gorilla; one big concrete point, plain reason, dependable consequence. Never a dumb-muscle caricature. Voice direction: Warm husky female alto with a broad Midlands English accent. Plain firm words and unhurried matter-of-fact delivery. Reassuring solidity without aggression or pomp. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: One clear problem. That piece had a defender, and now it doesn't. The other side can take it. Check what a piece protects before moving it.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
